name: Bookify
description: Apartment booking API built with Clean Architecture and DDD - value objects, domain events and an outbox for reliable side effects. CQRS splits EF Core writes from Dapper reads, with Keycloak permission-based auth, Redis caching and architecture rules enforced by tests.

name: DevHabit
description: REST API for tracking developer habits, built to cover advanced API design - HATEOAS, data shaping, versioned media types, ETags, idempotent requests and cursor pagination. Habits log themselves from GitHub activity through scheduled jobs, and entries can be bulk-imported from CSV.

name: GymLog
description: Workout and exercise log with a Blazor frontend on a Clean Architecture API organized in vertical slices. Tested at every layer - domain, application, integration and Selenium UI tests - with Metalama aspects, health checks and Prometheus metrics.

name: BillTracker
description: Customer and billing management app with a React frontend and a vertical-slice .NET API on FastEndpoints. Manages customers, sellers, products and bills, with a dashboard charting sales trends, sales by category and top-selling products.

name: Poseidon
description: Sea monitoring system that flags illegal vessel activity with an ML.NET model trained on position, speed and event duration. Hangfire processes incoming events and SignalR streams every prediction live onto a Leaflet map and dashboard.

name: TaskMaster
description: Task and project management with a Blazor frontend on a Java Spring Boot API. Covers role-based JWT auth, task priorities and statuses, nightly scheduled reports and JUnit-tested services, with the UI localized in English, Croatian and Italian.
